_comment: Feature-to-benefit knowledge base. Each rule matches against a parsed spec (its key and/or value) and emits a customer-facing benefit. Rules are evaluated highest-priority first. 'match' supports key_contains, value_contains, and text_contains (matches the combined 'key value'); all are lowercased substring checks and combined with AND.
